paragraphs: ShareStream sells the ShareStream Video Platform, a system for uploading, transcoding, editing, storing, managing and delivering media. The platform is built for educational institutions setting up an institution-wide video system that serves user groups and departments across campuses. Media Extensions for LMSs connect the platform to learning management systems including Blackboard Learn, Brightspace by D2L, Canvas by Instructure, Moodle and Sakai.

The platform was initially developed in collaboration with Georgetown University and is deployed at educational institutions and corporations around the world. ShareStream describes implementations at universities, colleges, K-12 schools and corporations. The California State University system selected the ShareStream Online Video Platform as one of two video-learning solutions for its campuses.

quote.text: ShareStream is the video platform for education.
